###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the muted-then-revealed collapsed case, with matching before/after screenshots.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the description, @FAzabmpc! Your Test 2 notes say a collapsed message from a muted user still shows in full after clicking "show more", but the issue asks for it to stay collapsed, so please fix that first. Then show precise before/after screenshots of the same scenario, following the [guide on presenting visual changes](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
